boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Immaculata University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and grocery destinations with documented service at 10 p.m. or later, spanning campus, Malvern, and West Chester.

cards.title: Keep the Run on Campus
cards.subtitle: Loyola Hall • Immaculata University
cards.notes: Walk to Loyola Hall before the weekday 10 p.m. close for made-to-order grill food, smoothies, flatbreads, milkshakes, or snacks.
cards.short_summary: The university’s own weekday late-menu counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Immaculata lists Grill on the Hill in Loyola Hall, describes its late-night menu, and posts Monday–Friday hours of 5–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours are Monday–Friday 5–10 p.m.; closed Saturday and open Sunday 5–8 p.m. Campus access and academic-break schedules may vary.

cards.title: Make It a King Street Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 19 E King Street • Malvern
cards.notes: Use this downtown Malvern counter for a Friday or Saturday pizza pickup, checking the online ordering cutoff before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A locally documented 11 p.m. weekend pizza option.
cards.evidence_claim: Malvern Pizza’s official location page lists 19 E King Street and closing times of 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The business posts 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday and Saturday; it closes at 10 p.m. Sunday and Tuesday–Thursday and is closed Monday.

cards.title: Build a Midnight Grocery Run
cards.subtitle: 50 Foundry Way • Malvern
cards.notes: Head here when the group needs groceries, prepared foods, or varied dietary options; confirm department counters before expecting full service.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day grocery fallback open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wegmans’ official Malvern store page lists 50 Foundry Way and store hours of 6 a.m.–midnight seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The store is posted open daily until midnight. Pharmacy and individual prepared-food counters have separate, earlier hours.

cards.title: Order Before the Pizza Cutoff
cards.subtitle: 490 Lancaster Avenue • Malvern
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery and verify the order tracker first; the Malvern shop extends its schedule an extra hour on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Malvern pizza shop serving through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: The mapped Domino’s listing identifies 490 Lancaster Avenue and posts service until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted delivery and takeout hours end at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm availability before ordering.

cards.title: Use the All-Night King Street Stop
cards.subtitle: 105 W King Street • Malvern
cards.notes: Stop for made-to-order food, coffee, or packaged snacks at any hour, but check the ordering screens because overnight food availability can change.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock convenience stop in Malvern.
cards.evidence_claim: Wawa’s official location page identifies Store 236 at 105 W King Street in Malvern as a 24-hour location.
cards.access_notes: The location is posted open 24 hours daily. Made-to-order food, fuel, and other services may have temporary overnight limitations.

cards.title: Take the Matthews Road Route
cards.subtitle: 5 Matthews Road • Malvern
cards.notes: Use this separate all-night Wawa for a quick food or snack stop when the King Street route is inconvenient; verify deli service on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A second distinct 24-hour Malvern convenience stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The location page for Wawa Store 205 identifies 5 Matthews Road in Malvern and lists the store as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The store is posted open 24 hours daily; confirm made-to-order food availability because individual services can pause overnight.

cards.title: Aim for the Late Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: 551 S Matlack Street • West Chester
cards.notes: Plan this farther run for Thursday through Saturday, when the shop posts an 11 p.m. close; call ahead if arriving near the cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-leaning pizza counter with an 11 p.m. window.
cards.evidence_claim: Riggtown Oven’s official site lists its West Chester address and hours until 11 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are until 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday, 10 p.m. Monday–Wednesday, and 9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Go Late for Halal Carryout
cards.subtitle: 38 E Market Street • West Chester
cards.notes: Use the Wednesday-through-Saturday window for halal wraps, platters, or vegetarian choices, and place carryout orders before the stated cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly halal kitchen with notably late service.
cards.evidence_claim: Shawarma Kebab’s official site identifies the West Chester restaurant as good for kids and posts business hours until 3 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Business hours are posted until 3 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday and midnight on other operating days; carryout ends at 2:30 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday.

cards.title: Save Room for the Diner Run
cards.subtitle: 1147 West Chester Pike • West Chester
cards.notes: Choose this long-hours diner when the group wants breakfast or a full meal late; check the live hours panel before making the longer drive.
cards.short_summary: A broad diner menu available into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: West Chester Diner’s official site lists its address, seven-day service, and a live closing time as late as 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official site’s hours panel shows service as late as 3 a.m.; the day-specific closing time should be checked before departure.

cards.title: Finish with a Cookie Pickup
cards.subtitle: 142 W Gay Street • West Chester
cards.notes: Check the store locator before leaving, then use the late bakery window for warm cookies or dessert delivery rather than a full meal.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-specific stop operating past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ official store locator presents late-night ordering, while its official West Chester announcement identifies the bakery at 142 W Gay Street.
cards.source_title: Warm Cookies Delivered Late | Insomnia Cookies Store Locator
cards.access_notes: The current mapped listing posts midnight closing Sunday–Wednesday and 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; verify the West Chester store in the official locator before ordering.
